name: Stable Safe Arc Throttle
philosophy: After seeing Staggered Gardener Cadence still reach round 2999, requiring longer safe arcs ensures gardeners arrive with escorts so the army can stay focused on fast closing instead of babysitting stray builds.
key_changes: Extend SafeArcTimer in BulletSpending.scanForSafeHireDirection() from three to five consecutive alignment checks before returning a stableDirection.
Add BulletSpending.isSafeArcStable() and guard RobotPlayer.runArchon() so BulletSpending.spendPolicy() is only invoked when the arc has persisted for the extended window.
engagement_style: Patient base defense that ripples out once the build arc is locked.
